summary.value: Outside a conflict scene, when you can attack a non-Villain, non-champion creature unaware of you and your allies: if it

system.description: Outside a conflict scene, when you can attack a non-Villain, non-champion creature unaware of you and your allies: if its level is at or below your level + (SL) it starts the ensuing conflict in Crisis; if at or below your level - (SL+1) it starts with 0 Hit Points. Affects only the attacked enemy.
